lines.zh: 细腿踩过落叶，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: Thin legs cross the leaves almost silently.

lines.zh: 白尾巴翘着，是给同伴看的。
lines.en: My white tail is raised for the herd to see.
I walk slowly along the forest edge.
My ears turn in every direction.
A step, a pause, listen, then look.

lines.zh: 蹄子在湿土上留下心形印。
lines.en: My hooves print hearts in the wet earth.
I emerge from behind the shrubs.

lines.zh: 脖子上还有冬天的绒毛。
lines.en: Winter fuzz still on my neck.
I step lightly, afraid to startle anyone.
My antlers scrape a branch.
I make a circuit of the wheat field.
When the grass moves, I change course.
Standing, ears never still.
I lower my head for a bite of grass.
A small flick of the white tail.
A bird calls; I look up.
I chew slowly, mouthful by mouthful.
I keep my ears up a long while.

lines.zh: 我把前蹄在地上刨了两下。
lines.en: I paw the ground twice.

lines.zh: 我竖着耳朵，嚼两口停下。
lines.en: Ears up, I chew twice and stop.
Stand right there and do not move.
My tail flicks up — I'm about to bolt.
I am walking away now.
Stay away from the wheat.

lines.zh: 我们隔着这段距离说话。
lines.en: We talk from this distance.
Your shadow is too long.
Do not come this way.
I am not here to be chased.
The shock makes me leap.
That landed on my leg.
My leg is bleeding.
That hurt badly.
My hide is scraped and I pant hard.
I must run now.
My ears are flat against my head.
I will get up again.
Wheat. Real wheat.
Let me come closer and sniff.
Put it down and step back.
Grass is scarce this season.
Shake it, and I bolt.
I like tender leaves.
Not too close. I get nervous.
One bite and I am gone.
Chase me and it is gone.
You bumped me and I flinched.
My legs are thin. I balance poorly.
Get back. I need to run.
Did my hoof catch you?
Do not grab my coat.
Let us just pass each other.
I hop half a step aside.
My shadow is under your feet.
That waits until autumn.
First, show me your antlers.
We are all busy this season.
I must first be sure no wolves are near.
There are a few deer in this wood.
Let us eat some grass first.
There is no need to hurry.
I do not want to draw predators.
Somewhere quieter.
A fruit rolled to my feet.

lines.zh: 这捆小麦，我先闻再叼走。
lines.en: This bundle of wheat, I sniff before I take it.
Is this even edible?
I touch it with my lip.
Too hard. I ignore it.
This ground is wet.
Something is at my feet.
I lift a hoof and step over.
I did not drop this.

lines.zh: 我的角，只在逃的时候用。
lines.en: My antlers are only for fleeing.
I lift a foreleg.
I do not want to fight you.
Back off or I butt you.
These horns of mine can be used.
My herd is over there.
You mean to take my grass.
You are under my watch.
Do not seal the path.
I will run for my life.
Push me and I charge.
My hooves are planted to spring.
The forest is close.
I count down from three.
I am running.
I stare at you, legs taut.
One more step and I bolt.
At this distance I can still flee.
You have no bow, do you?
One hoof scrapes the ground.
I glance left.
There are thicker trees there.
The wind has shifted.
You are blocking the wheat.
I wait for an opening.
My horns point at you.
Any closer and I charge.
My hind legs are adjusting.
I puff out a cloud of breath.
Not yet.
Good. This one moment.
I burst out.
My horn tips thrust forward.
I butt into your side.
A hoof grazes your leg.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，后蹄踢出去。
lines.en: I spin and kick with both hinds.
After the hit I back off.
I toss my head hard.
My antler rakes your arm.
One shove and you let go.
My antler tip drives into your chest.
I spring forward and push.
My hoof rings on your bracer.

lines.zh: 我甩头，用角挑开你的手。
lines.en: I toss my head and hook your arm away.
Hind legs load and I slam in.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也被弹开。
lines.en: That one threw me back too.
I lower my neck and thrust again.
An antler snags your sleeve.
Hit, and I turn at once.
I am still up. Do not push me.
A flash of white tail.
This wood is quiet.
First I raise my head and scan.
The wind bends the grass.

lines.zh: 我是从平原那边过来的。
lines.en: I came from the plains.
There is a herd deeper in.
I come to a soft stop.
My shadow falls on the leaves.
The soil under my hooves is still soft.
I step out from behind a tree.
Fire singes my coat.

lines.zh: 我从坡上跳下，落地时腿一软。
lines.en: I jump from a slope and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 爆炸声把我吓得四蹄乱跳。
lines.en: The blast makes all four hooves scramble.
The arrow shaft still quivers in my shoulder.
This light makes me dizzy.
Grass is scarce in winter; I have grown thin.

lines.zh: 闪电打在林子上，我全身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the wood and I shudder.
No ground. My hooves find nothing.
